name: cut_tiles
description: hard-cut tiles in violet, peach and blue round small spirals, white gaps between them holding the set's grey lace, along escape bands patterned with a brick lattice
notes: From lethe-25.jpg (item 053). The tiles are the strip trap's blades read as `step` at three cycles of the map, laid normal, so each blade is one flat hue with a hard edge, cut by the set's own pullbacks; the brick lattice is the escape-band checker at 16 sectors multiplied in; the dark seams are a period-1 sheet on the smooth count; the white gaps are a second, narrow strip (tilt 90, radius 0.04) painted solid only at its coarse entries (largest 0.35, smallest 0.12), with the set's de hairline multiplied over them so each gap still holds lace. Round one first drew the gaps at radius 0.08 down to 0.06 of the frame: at a slow-escaping Mandelbrot spiral every step lands another entry in that window and white flooded the frame. A spiral reference, so spiral seats. No engine change. Explorer cost (080, `style cost`, read beside other Node workers: an upper bound): 48 s as WebAssembly on one thread at 1280x800 ss2 at its deepest kept seat (julia-mandelbrot_9178ac7c, maxiter 9,326), under the 5-minute bar.
